name: Coffee crumb cake
origin: A moist, sour-cream-enriched American butter cake (not necessarily flavoured with coffee itself — 'coffee cake' names what it is eaten alongside), topped with a cinnamon streusel crumb.

ingredients.note: sour cream is a substantial, defining liquid for this style of American cake; modelled with the registry's cream substance, the nearest real analogue — the bacterial culturing that sours cream is a fermentation step this registry does not yet distinguish from sweet cream

process.name: cream butter and sugar
process.description: beat butter and sugar until light

process.name: add eggs and sour cream
process.description: beat in eggs, then the sour cream

process.name: fold in flour and spice
process.description: fold in flour, leavening, salt and cinnamon

process.name: top with streusel and bake
process.description: press a separately-mixed cinnamon-sugar-butter-flour streusel over the batter, then bake

notes: A representative sour-cream American butter cake, moister and slightly leaner in egg than a Victoria sponge. The streusel crumb topping is a separately-mixed component pressed onto the batter before baking; consistent with the scope note in catalog.ts, it is described in the process step but kept out of the ingredient list, since it never actually mixes into the batter itself.
